evals.title: Desktop to ward tablet
evals.prompt: Convert a 12-column inpatient worklist to tablet.
evals.expected_output: Column priority/disclosure preserves comparison and patient context; no giant card waterfall.
assertions: Task-critical identity/scope survives the viewport change.
High-value columns/content are prioritized rather than blindly stacked.
Primary actions remain reachable.
Comparison relationships are not destroyed by cardification.
No essential value is hover-only.
Touch targets and reading order remain usable.
